text:
Harper: two tiny life updates 1 1: promoted to Staff SWE and my partner and i just adopted a dog! thinking a little courtyard hang + coffee Tuesday 10:30am to celebrate. who can make it?
Noah: HUGE congrats!! adopt pics pls :dog: :heart_eyes:
Harper: pic incoming in a sec: https://imgur.com/a/harper-pup (tiny golden mutt named 'Pip'). promotion is effective next month.
Riya: omg pip is adorable!! congrats on both. i can swing by 10:30 and will bring coffee.
Sam: congrats harper!! can we do a small group card + a welcome-dog toy? i can coordinate a $ collection form.
Maya: congrats 1 also i'll bring a dairy-free pastry. quick q: is this ok to be a ~15min courtyard pop-in for folks between meetings?
Harper: yes absolutely, totally casual. 15 minutes is perfect.
pyro-bot: Proposed event: "Harper: staff promo + pup welcome" Tue 10:30 AM 1 Courtyard. React with :thumbsup: to RSVP.
Jo: :thumbsup: count me in. bringing a small chew toy and some dog treats. do you have any food allergies we should avoid bringing near Pip?
Harper: Pip is fine with all normal treats but we avoid chocolate and grapes. thanks jo!
Diego: congrats! i can bring a tiny welcome mat for the desk (lol). also vote for cupcakes or mini bagels?
Noah: bagels > cupcakes for me, but cupcakes are cute.
Riya: mini bagels please.
Sam: here's the short contributions form for card/gift (opt-in): https://forms.gle/pup-welcome (short link). i'll handle collecting and buying the toy if people contribute.
Maya: will react to pyro-bot and add to my calendar. congrats again harper!!
Harper: you all are so sweet, thank you. remote folks: feel free to drop a quick video or gif and i'll play it for pip :)
Noah: dropping a ridiculous party GIF in thread :confetti_ball: :doggo_party:
pyro-bot: Event created: "Harper: staff promo + pup welcome" Tue 10:30 AM 1 Courtyard. Invites sent to team@redwood.com
Sam: added to calendar + will pick up the toy after standup. see you Tuesday!
_meta: watercooler slack thread: congrats on promotion + dog adoption, informal courtyard meetup planning, links to images and collection form, bot event
